text: I think I have just the thing for you! This Curried Chicken Salad With Mangoes and Cashews recipe is a perfect fit for your dietary needs and preferences. As a gluten-free option, the croissants are not actually necessary, and you can simply omit them or substitute with a gluten-free alternative. The dish is also high in protein, with 26 grams per serving, which aligns with your health goal. The combination of chicken, mango, and cashews will provide a satisfying and flavorful meal that can be prepared in just 10 minutes, fitting within your time budget.
